name: frontend-react-plugin
description: Frontend React development plugin for Claude Code with two app profiles — admin (Vite SPA) and OTA (React Router framework mode, SSR/SSG, TanStack Query, RHF+zod, Playwright) — enforcing React 19, TypeScript, shadcn/ui or an external design system, and i18next conventions; Phase 2 adds workspace API packages, custom i18n bindings and store-less apps
